about: A Ruby library for working with web addresses, with forgiving parsing and address templates.

prs.title: A local address with a port is read as host and port
prs.broken: The forgiving address parser read a local address with a port as a strange scheme with no host, while other hosts with ports were read correctly.
prs.changed: A local name followed by a port number is now read as host and port, as a browser would. Phone and other real schemes stay as they were.
prs.matters: Apps that accept typed addresses handle local development servers the way users expect.
